    # Fill the textbox to trigger the dropdown for selecting members
    await page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Select members to invite').fill('Vinta')
    # Wait for the dropdown to appear and select the user 'Vinta Chen @vinta'
    await page.get_by_role('option', name='Vinta Chen @vinta').click()

    await page.get_by_role('button', name='Add to project').click()
